t: Santo Domingo was founded by the Spanish in 1496 on land that belonged to the Taíno chiefdoms of Hispaniola, and it became the first seat of Spanish colonial rule in the Americas and the starting point of expeditions to Puerto Rico, Cuba, Mexico and the Pacific.

After Francis Drake captured the city in 1586 and Spanish policy emptied most of the island outside the capital, the city passed between Spain, France, Haiti and its own independent governments, and it was the capital of free nations in 1821 and 1844.
It was named Ciudad Trujillo from 1936 to 1961, suffered a hurricane in 1930 and heavy fighting in 1965, and is today the capital and largest city of the Dominican Republic.
dyk: The first major slave revolt in the Americas took place in Santo Domingo in 1521, when enslaved Africans rose on Diego Columbus's sugar plantation.
ev: The Spanish found the settlement on the Ozama River as La Nueva Isabela
A hurricane destroys the city, and Governor Nicolás de Ovando has it rebuilt across the river
Enslaved Africans rise on Diego Columbus's sugar plantation in the first major slave revolt in the Americas
Sir Francis Drake captures the city and holds it for ransom
Spain cedes the city and its colony to France, and for almost three decades it changes hands several times
Santo Domingo becomes the capital of a free nation after independence from Haiti
The city is renamed Ciudad Trujillo after the dictator Rafael Trujillo
Fighting between Constitucionalistas and United States troops ends with 2,850 Dominicans and 44 American servicemen dead

f.founded: Founded by Bartholomew Columbus in 1496 under the Spanish Empire as La Nueva Isabela, and officially dated from 5 August 1498; the city was rebuilt on the other side of the Ozama after a hurricane in 1502.
f.where: On the southern coast of the island of Hispaniola, on the Caribbean Sea, at the mouth of the Ozama River, in the present-day Dominican Republic.
f.known: The first seat of Spanish colonial rule in the Americas; the first cathedral, castle, monastery, fortress and university of the New World; the launching point of expeditions to Puerto Rico, Cuba, Mexico and the Pacific; the first major slave revolt in the Americas in 1521; Drake's capture in 1586; the years as Ciudad Trujillo
f.today: Santo Domingo is the capital and largest city of the Dominican Republic, coterminous with the Distrito Nacional, and its Colonial Zone is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
